question: Which among the following Articles of the Indian Constitution deals with the "Fundamental Duties"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**51-A.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 51-A **of the Indian Constitution deals with the **"Fundamental Duties".**
 
• Fundamental Duties were added to the Constitution by the **42nd Amendment Act in 1976.**
 
• These duties are** non-enforceable in nature **but are considered essential for the growth and development of an individual as well as society.
 
• **The 11 Fundamental Duties** include respect for the Constitution, national symbols, and institutions; promotion of harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood; safeguarding public property; and protecting the natural environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** ****Article 55-A: **This article does not exist in the Indian Constitution. Hence, option 1 is incorrect.
 
• **Article 61-A: **This article was added to the Constitution by the 44th Amendment Act in 1978. It deals with the appointment of a Prime Minister or Chief Minister who is not a member of the legislature. Hence, option 3 is incorrect.
 
• **Article 54-A:** This article does not exist in the Indian Constitution. Hence, option 4 is incorrect.
